[
{"id":"ka0525","verbatim":"We expect to remediate these material weaknesses in fiscal 2022.","paraphrase":"Management anticipates that the correction of these material weaknesses will be completed in the 2020 fiscal year.","different_hard":"We do not expect to remediate these material weaknesses in fiscal 2020."},
{"id":"ka0526","verbatim":"In the past, we have experienced social engineering, phishing, malware and comparable attacks and threats of denial-of-service attacks; however, such attacks could in the future have a material adverse effect on our operations.","paraphrase":"Although we have previously been subject to social engineering, phishing, malware and other comparable attacks, as well as threats of denial-of-service attacks, these types of attacks may materially and adversely affect our operations going forward.","different_hard":"In the past, we have not experienced social engineering, phishing, malware or similar attacks or threats of denial-of-service attacks; however, such attacks could in the future have a material adverse effect on our operations."},
{"id":"ka0527","verbatim":"We may also make unsecured loans to investee companies, meaning that such loans will not benefit from any security interest over the assets of such companies.","paraphrase":"We may also extend loans on an unsecured basis to portfolio companies, which means these loans would not be supported by any security interest in the assets of those companies.","different_hard":"We may also make secured loans to portfolio companies, meaning that such loans will benefit from a security interest over the assets of such companies."},
{"id":"ka0528","verbatim":"If we are unable to retain or motivate key personnel or hire qualified staff, we may not be able to grow effectively.","paraphrase":"Should we fail to keep or inspire our key employees, or to recruit skilled personnel, our ability to grow effectively may be impaired.","different_hard":"If we are able to retain and motivate key personnel and hire qualified personnel, we may grow effectively."},
{"id":"ka0529","verbatim":"The Hatch-Waxman Amendments allow a patent term extension of up to five years for a patent covering an approved product as compensation for effective patent term lost during product development and the FDA regulatory review process.","paraphrase":"Under the Hatch-Waxman Amendments, a patent covering an approved product may have its term lengthened by as much as five years, to compensate for the effective patent term consumed during product development and FDA regulatory review.","different_hard":"The Hatch-Waxman Amendments prohibit a patent term extension of up to five years for a patent covering an approved product as compensation for effective patent term lost during product development and the FDA regulatory review process."},
{"id":"ka0530","verbatim":"The success of our entertainment business is largely dependent on the continued success of our Holiday Spectacular and the TAO Group business, and the availability of, and our venues’ ability to attract, concerts, family shows and other events, competition for which is intense, and the ability of acts to attract strong attendance at our venues.","paraphrase":"Our entertainment segment's performance depends heavily on the sustained popularity of our Christmas Spectacular show and the TAO Group operations, as well as on the supply of concerts, family productions and other events, for which competition is fierce, and on performers' capacity to draw strong crowds to our venues.","different_hard":"The success of our entertainment business is largely independent of the continued success of our Christmas Spectacular and the TAO Group business, and the availability of, and our venues’ ability to attract, concerts, family shows and other events, competition for which is intense, and the ability of acts to attract strong attendance at our venues."},
{"id":"ka0531","verbatim":"An externally caused information security incident, such as a hacker intrusion, virus or worm, or an internally caused issue, such as failure to control access to sensitive systems, could materially interrupt business operations or cause disclosure or modification of sensitive or confidential client or competitive information and could result in material financial loss, loss of competitive position, regulatory actions, breach of client contracts, reputational harm or legal liability.","paraphrase":"A security breach originating outside the company, for example through hacking, a virus or a worm, or one originating internally, such as inadequate control over access to sensitive systems, could materially disrupt operations or lead to the exposure or alteration of information that is sensitive or confidential, whether it relates to clients or to competitive matters, and could cause material financial losses, erosion of competitive standing, regulatory enforcement, violations of client agreements, damage to reputation or legal liability.","different_hard":"An externally caused information security incident, such as a hacker attack, virus or worm, or an internally caused issue, such as failure to control access to sensitive systems, could materially interrupt business operations or cause disclosure or modification of sensitive or confidential client or competitive information and could result in minor financial loss, loss of competitive position, regulatory actions, breach of client contracts, reputational harm or legal liability."},
{"id":"ka0532","verbatim":"Generally, these lawsuits have alleged the existence of a conspiracy among manufacturers of competing products, distributors and/or operators of GPOs, including us, to deny the plaintiff access to a market for specific products, to raise the prices for products and/or to limit the plaintiff's choice of products to buy.","paraphrase":"Such suits have usually claimed that manufacturers of rival products, distributors and/or operators of GPOs, among them us, have colluded to shut the plaintiff out of a market for certain goods, drive up prices and/or restrict the plaintiff's product options.","different_hard":"Typically, these lawsuits have alleged the existence of a conspiracy among manufacturers of competing products, distributors and/or operators of GPOs, excluding us, to deny the plaintiff access to a market for certain products, to raise the prices for products and/or to limit the plaintiff's choice of products to buy."},
{"id":"ka0533","verbatim":"The same is true for our efforts to expand in these markets with the hiring of further seasoned professionals with significant experience in that market.","paraphrase":"This also applies to our attempts to grow in these markets by recruiting more veteran professionals who have substantial experience in that market.","different_hard":"The same is not true for our efforts to expand in these markets with the hiring of additional seasoned professionals with significant experience in that market."},
{"id":"ka0534","verbatim":"The reliability and security of our information technology infrastructure and software, and our ability to expand and continually update technologies in response to our evolving needs is critical to our business.","paraphrase":"Our business critically depends on the dependability and protection of our IT infrastructure and software, as well as on our capacity to extend and keep upgrading technologies so they respond to our shifting requirements.","different_hard":"The reliability and security of our information technology infrastructure and software, and our ability to expand and continually update technologies in response to our changing needs is not critical to our business."},
{"id":"ka0535","verbatim":"fluctuations in occupancy, including as a result of general economic conditions, competition and willingness or ability of prospective residents to relocate to our assisted living facilities;","paraphrase":"changes in occupancy levels, driven in part by overall economic conditions, competitive pressures and the readiness or capacity of prospective residents to move into our assisted living communities;","different_hard":"stability in occupancy, including as a result of general economic conditions, competition and willingness or ability of prospective residents to relocate to our assisted living communities;"},
{"id":"ka0536","verbatim":"Our operations are regulated extensively at the federal, state and municipal levels.","paraphrase":"Federal, state and local authorities impose extensive regulation on our business activities.","different_hard":"Our operations are regulated minimally at the federal, state and local levels."},
{"id":"ka0537","verbatim":"Further, if Crescent allocates the obligation to purchase forward purchase units to a Crescent Fund, such Crescent Fund Purchaser’s and any permitted transferee’s obligations to purchase the forward purchase units will be subject to termination prior to the closing of the sale of such securities by mutual written consent of the Company and such party, or automatically: (i) if our Initial Business Combination is not consummated within 24 months (by March 12, 2023) from the Initial Public Offering; or (ii) if we become subject to any voluntary or involuntary petition under the United States federal bankruptcy laws or any state insolvency law, in each case which is not withdrawn within sixty (60) days after being filed, or a receiver, fiscal agent or similar officer is appointed by a court for business or property of us, in each case which is not removed, withdrawn or terminated within sixty (60) days after such appointment.","paraphrase":"Moreover, should Crescent assign the duty to buy forward purchase units to a Crescent Fund, the obligations of that Crescent Fund purchaser and of any permitted transferee to buy those forward purchase units will be subject to termination before the closing of the sale of such securities, either by mutual written agreement of the Company and that party or automatically in the following cases: (i) our Initial Business Combination has not been completed within 24 months (March 12, 2021) after the Initial Public Offering; or (ii) we become the subject of a voluntary or involuntary bankruptcy petition under US federal law or any state insolvency statute and it is not dismissed within sixty (60) days of filing, or a court appoints a receiver, fiscal agent or similar officer over our business or property and that appointment is not lifted, withdrawn or ended within sixty (60) days of the appointment.","different_hard":"Further, if Crescent allocates the obligation to purchase forward purchase units to a Crescent Fund, such Crescent Fund Purchaser’s and any permitted transferee’s obligations to purchase the forward purchase units will not be subject to termination prior to the closing of the sale of such securities by mutual written consent of the Company and such party, or automatically: (i) if our Initial Business Combination is not consummated within 24 months (by March 12, 2021) from the Initial Public Offering; or (ii) if we become subject to any voluntary or involuntary petition under the United States federal bankruptcy laws or any state insolvency law, in each case which is not withdrawn within sixty (60) days after being filed, or a receiver, fiscal agent or similar officer is appointed by a court for business or property of us, in each case which is not removed, withdrawn or terminated within sixty (60) days after such appointment."},
{"id":"ka0538","verbatim":"In addition, prospective purchasers may have difficulty obtaining financing.","paraphrase":"Furthermore, potential buyers may find it hard to secure financing.","different_hard":"In addition, prospective buyers may have no difficulty obtaining financing."},
{"id":"ka0539","verbatim":"In addition, the 11 Federal Home Loan Banks are jointly liable for the combined obligations of the FHLB system.","paraphrase":"Furthermore, the eleven Federal Home Loan Banks are collectively responsible, on a joint basis, for the consolidated debt of the FHLB System.","different_hard":"In addition, the 11 Federal Home Loan Banks are individually liable for the consolidated obligations of the FHLB system."},
{"id":"ka0540","verbatim":"Any significant variations in the cost and availability of our specialty and commodity materials may negatively affect our business, financial condition or results of operations, specifically for the Advanced Materials Segment.","paraphrase":"Significant fluctuations in the price or availability of our specialty and commodity inputs may adversely affect our business, financial position or operating results, particularly with respect to the Specialty Chemicals Segment.","different_hard":"Any significant variations in the cost and availability of our specialty and commodity materials may positively affect our business, financial condition or results of operations, specifically for the Specialty Chemicals Segment."},
{"id":"ka0541","verbatim":"Berkeley Point Capital LLC, a subsidiary within our real estate capital markets business, is approved as a Fannie Mae DUS lender, a Freddie Mac Program Plus seller/servicer, a Freddie Mac Targeted Affordable Housing Seller, a HUD MAP lender nationally, and a Ginnie Mae issuer.","paraphrase":"Berkeley Point Capital LLC, a unit of our real estate capital markets operation, holds approval to serve as a Fannie Mae DUS lender, as a Freddie Mac Program Plus seller/servicer, as a Targeted Affordable Housing Seller for Freddie Mac, as a HUD MAP lender nationwide, and as a Ginnie Mae issuer.","different_hard":"Berkeley Point Capital LLC, a subsidiary within our real estate capital markets business, is not approved as a Fannie Mae DUS lender, a Freddie Mac Program Plus seller/servicer, a Freddie Mac Targeted Affordable Housing Seller, a HUD MAP lender nationwide, or a Ginnie Mae issuer."},
{"id":"ka0542","verbatim":"Our operations to date have been limited to organizing and staffing our company, business planning, raising capital, acquiring and developing our technology, identifying potential product candidates, undertaking nonclinical studies, and preparing for, commencing and conducting clinical trials of our lead product candidate, pegzilarginase.","paraphrase":"To date, our activities have consisted solely of establishing and staffing the company, planning our business, raising funds, acquiring and developing our technology, identifying possible product candidates, carrying out nonclinical studies, and getting ready for, starting and running clinical trials of our leading product candidate, pegzilarginase.","different_hard":"Our operations to date have been limited to organizing and staffing our company, business planning, raising capital, acquiring and developing our technology, identifying potential product candidates, undertaking nonclinical studies, and preparing for, commencing and conducting commercial sales of our most advanced product candidate, pegzilarginase."},
{"id":"ka0543","verbatim":"expenditures that we may incur to acquire and develop additional drug candidates and technologies;","paraphrase":"costs we may bear in acquiring and advancing more product candidates and technologies;","different_hard":"expenditures that we may incur to sell and divest additional product candidates and technologies;"},
{"id":"ka0544","verbatim":"Because distributions of capital surplus will reduce the minimum quarterly distribution after any of these distributions are made, the effects of distributions of capital surplus may make it simpler for our general partner to receive incentive distributions.","paraphrase":"Since capital surplus distributions lower the minimum quarterly distribution once they have been made, such distributions may ease our general partner's path to earning incentive distributions.","different_hard":"Because distributions of capital surplus will increase the minimum quarterly distribution after any of these distributions are made, the effects of distributions of capital surplus may make it easier for our general partner to receive incentive distributions."},
{"id":"ka0545","verbatim":"We may obtain only limited warranties when we acquire a property.","paraphrase":"Upon buying a property, we may secure only limited warranties.","different_hard":"We may obtain comprehensive warranties when we purchase a property."},
{"id":"ka0546","verbatim":"We enter into diverse financial transactions with multiple counterparties to mitigate our currency risk.","paraphrase":"We conduct a variety of financial dealings with a number of counterparties in order to lessen our currency risk.","different_hard":"We enter into diverse financial transactions with several counterparties to increase our currency risk."},
{"id":"ka0547","verbatim":"Additionally, the emergence of new industry standards related to strategic planning and operational execution products and services may adversely affect the demand for our platform.","paraphrase":"Moreover, new industry standards that emerge for strategy planning and operational execution offerings could adversely impact demand for our platform.","different_hard":"Further, the emergence of new industry standards related to strategic planning and operational execution products and services may favorably affect the demand for our platform."},
{"id":"ka0548","verbatim":"Apart from Texas v. United States, ACA litigation continues nationwide in district and appellate courts, and before the Supreme Court.","paraphrase":"Except for Texas v. United States, challenges under the ACA are still pending nationally before district and appellate courts as well as the Supreme Court.","different_hard":"Apart from Texas v. United States, ACA litigation has ended across the country in district and appellate courts, and before the Supreme Court."},
{"id":"ka0549","verbatim":"If we are unable to do so, the institution may offer the intellectual property rights to others, possibly blocking our ability to pursue our program.","paraphrase":"Should we fail to do so, the institution could make the intellectual property rights available to other parties, which may block us from pursuing our program.","different_hard":"If we are unable to do so, the institution may offer the intellectual property rights to others, potentially enabling our ability to pursue our program."}
